answer: A staking bond stops sybil swarms: each agent locks a deposit behind a cipher-verified identity key, and the bond only unlocks after a long horizon of honest attestations. One operator running thousands of fake agents must fund every bond, so the cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. If a node is caught cheating, its bond is slashed, turning the frozen tundra of idle sockpuppets into a direct financial loss instead of free votes.
